title: Eleven Minutes Nobody Heard
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：act　|　正文 377 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 act 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 my father directed a school play and cut the second ① act because it was eleven minutes too long, and Ellis, who had one line in it, learned the line anyway and said it to an empty hall on the last afternoon. My father called it an ② act of kindness and wrote it in a letter, and said an act is only a word for what somebody did when nobody was counting.

He was ③ caught in the act of putting the line back into the script in 1971, by which I mean my mother found him at the table with a pen at two in the morning, and she said nothing and made tea. It was the ④ act that decided it, she told me thirty years later, and by it she meant not the pen but the two o'clock, and the fact that he had done it nine times.

On the last night Ellis ⑤ put on an act for his mother in the front row, meaning he bowed twice and nobody clapped, and my father said the boy had understood something most of them never do. There was a ⑥ comedy act after the play, two boys and a chair, and it got the laugh the play had been written for, and my father sat through it with his hands in his pockets.

In 1974 the ⑦ Act went through, the one about schools and halls and who may stand on a stage, and my father read it twice and said an act of that kind is a promise with a date on it. He never ⑧ acted on it — the hall stayed open and the play stayed cut — and when I asked him why he said that some acts are passed so that other acts do not have to be.

The  act I remember is the second one, the eleven minutes he cut and Ellis said anyway to nobody, in a hall with one chair in it. The  act that nobody saw is the only one I have ever told anybody about. An act, my father wrote in 1981, is the only thing a man leaves that is exactly the size of the man; everything else is either bigger or smaller, and mostly it is smaller.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. 表演；节目（a comedy act）
D. n. 法案；法令（an Act of Parliament）
E. 固定搭配：an act of kindness / courage 善举／勇敢之举
F. 固定搭配：in the act of doing sth. 正在做某事时
G. 固定搭配：act on / upon sth. 根据……行事；照……办
H. 固定搭配：put on an act 装样子；装腔作势

items.q: cut the second act because it was
an act of kindness and wrote it
caught in the act of putting
It was the act that decided it
put on an act for his mother
There was a comedy act after the play
the Act went through, the one about

answers.why: act 意为“（戏剧的）幕”，1969 年父亲删掉了第二幕，因为它长了十一分钟。
an act of kindness 意为“善举”，埃利斯对着空礼堂仍把台词说完，父亲称那是善举。
in the act of doing sth. 意为“正在做某事时”，母亲凌晨两点当场撞见他在把台词改回剧本。
act 意为“行为、举动”，母亲说决定性的不是那支笔，而是凌晨两点这个举动本身。
put on an act 意为“装样子、装腔作势”，埃利斯在前排为母亲装模作样地鞠了两次躬。
comedy act 意为“喜剧表演、滑稽节目”，两个男孩和一把椅子拿到了本该属于那出戏的笑声。
Act 意为“法案、法令”，1974 年那项关于学校礼堂的法案通过了。
act on sth. 意为“照……行事”，父亲从未照那部法案行事，礼堂照旧开着。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年我父亲把第二幕删掉了，因为它长了十一分钟。（act）
他称那是善举，并把它写进了一封信里。（an act of kindness）
母亲凌晨两点当场撞见他正在把那句台词改回剧本。（in the act of）
最后一晚，埃利斯在前排为他母亲装模作样地鞠了两次躬。（put on an act）
1974 年那项关于学校礼堂的法案通过了。（Act）
他从未照它行事：礼堂照旧开着，那出戏照旧是删过的。（act on）
answers: In 1969 my father cut the second act because it was eleven minutes too long.
He called it an act of kindness and wrote it in a letter.
My mother caught him in the act of putting the line back into the script at two in the morning.
On the last night Ellis put on an act for his mother in the front row and bowed twice.
In 1974 the Act about schools and halls went through.
He never acted on it: the hall stayed open and the play stayed cut.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 act 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 my father cut the second act of the school play because it was eleven minutes too long.
He called it an act of kindness when Ellis said the line to an empty hall.
My mother caught him in the act of putting the line back into the script at two in the morning.
Ellis put on an act for his mother in the front row, and there was a comedy act after the play.
In 1974 the Act went through, but he never acted on it and the hall stayed open.
The act I remember is the second one, the eleven minutes he cut and Ellis said anyway to nobody.
